version.approval_notes: Build with Bun 1.3.11: run bun install --frozen-lockfile, then bun run build. The output is dist/. Source includes bun.lock and docs/publishing.md. This extension captures audio on user request and stores it locally. The alarms permission wakes the non-persistent background for recording duration limits and stop timeouts. See docs/publishing.md for the remaining permission rationale.
